main_text.p: רָפָה Remiffum, Defidem effe, Defiftere, Deficere: Niphal נִרְפֶּה Idem. Pihel רִפָּה Remiffum reddidit, Debilitavit, Deftitult, Deficere fecit. Hiphil הִרְפָּה Deftere, Abfiftere, Sinere, Remittere, Dimittere. Hithpahel הִתְרַפָּה Remiffe fe gerere, Remiffe agere.
רָפֶה adj. Remiffus. Debilis: plur. fem. רָפּוֹת.
רָפָא m. Gigas: pl. רְפָאִים Gigantes: item Mortui, quasi Defiti, qui vivere Defierunt.
Niphal נִרְפַּס Conturbari. Hithpahel הִתְרַפֵּס Subjicere se, & quasi Calcandum se præbere.
רפק Hithpahel הִתְרַפֵּק Adhaerere, Associare se.
רפש Vide paulò ante in רָפַשׂ.
רָצַר Pihel Dejicere, Deprimere se: juxta Hebræos, Exfilire, Exsultare.
